subtitle.text: As a Multimedia Computer Engineer with over four years of professional experience, I specialize in architecting, developing, and deploying scalable web systems, cross-platform mobile applications, and AI-assisted automation workflows. My engineering background enables me to bridge software architecture, process automation, and creative digital production to deliver high-performance solutions.

software.subtitle: Building robust, scalable applications with modern software engineering practices, clean architecture, and type-safe systems.

web.title: Web Applications
web.desc: Single Page Applications (SPAs) and Server-Side Rendered portals built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Optimized for responsiveness, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), and high Core Web Vitals performance.

mobile.title: Mobile Development
mobile.desc: Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android powered by React Native and Expo, featuring offline-first persistence, real-time sync, and fluid native animations.

api.title: APIs & Microservices
api.desc: RESTful services and backend API integration using Node.js, Express, and Python. Designed for secure authentication, clean data validation, and payment gateway integrations (WebPay, Stripe).

database.title: Databases & Cloud
database.desc: Relational and NoSQL database modeling with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Firebase Cloud Services. Focused on query optimization, index design, and data integrity.

sdd.title: Engineering & SDD Practices
sdd.desc: Spec-Driven Development (SDD), agentic AI workflows, version control with Git, automated testing pipelines, and continuous deployment for maintainable software architecture.

it.title: IT Support & Infrastructure
it.desc: Preventive hardware and software maintenance, LAN network configuration, formatting, OS installation (Linux and Windows), and comprehensive technical support.

multimedia.subtitle: Leveraging generative AI, cinematic video production, audio synthesis, and process automation to complement software engineering.

horror_movie.process: Midjourney v6 dark scene composition with high-contrast color grading and film grain post-production.

wizard.title: Mystical Sorcerer Concept Art
wizard.desc: Detailed fantasy concept art showcasing a wizard casting elemental spell energy in an ancient mystical realm.
wizard.process: SDXL ControlNet pose control, custom particle lighting effects, and ComfyUI workflow refinement.

video.title: Cinematic AI Video Generation & Editing
video.desc: Creating cinematic visual storytelling, AI video generation (Runway, Luma, Pika), shot composition, color grading, and post-production video editing for promotional media.

image.title: AI Image Generation & Digital Assets
image.desc: High-resolution visual asset synthesis using Midjourney, Flux, and ComfyUI node workflows, tailored for UI mockups, brand collateral, and digital marketing graphics.

audio.title: AI Voice Generation & Audio Post-Production
audio.desc: Realistic voiceover synthesis with ElevenLabs, audio noise reduction, background music mixing, and localized voice production for multimedia content.

automation.title: Development Agents & Workflow Automation
automation.desc: Implementing autonomous AI coding assistants (Cursor, Antigravity, Claude Code), custom agentic tools, automated task orchestration, and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) pipelines.

skills.description: With experience both as an employee and a freelancer, I have developed a well-rounded perspective on the industry and the flexibility to collaborate with diverse teams and projects. My focus on achieving results, combined with a strong passion for learning, has helped me excel in my career and drive successful outcomes. As a Multimedia Computer Engineer, I systematically apply clean code principles, software engineering methodologies, and multidisciplinary design.

software.title: Software Engineering & Mobile

ai.title: AI & Workflow Automation

archbishopric.description: As Web Master and Software Developer at Archbishopric of La Serena, I design, develop, and maintain high-quality web and mobile applications using React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and MySQL. I engineered an internal CMS/CRUD system for news and multimedia management, integrated WebPay payment services, and managed server infrastructure and database integrity.

freelance.description: As a freelance developer, I designed and optimized full-stack web and mobile solutions for entrepreneurs and startups using React.js, Python, Node.js, and MongoDB. Developed SEO-optimized web applications, custom APIs, task management tools, and e-commerce platforms with efficient databases and modern responsive design.

midlevel.description: As a mid-level software engineer, I lead technical architecture and best practices across modern web, mobile, and AI-assisted automation projects. I build scalable, performant, and user-centric applications, leveraging React Native, Next.js, Node.js, and Spec-Driven Development workflows.
